# infrawrench_posture_alert_settings (Resource)

Whether posture-check findings — public buckets, wide-open security groups, unencrypted volumes — raise notifications for this organization.

Which findings are *produced* is not configured here: the checks always run and the results are always on the posture page. This only decides whether anyone is told without looking.

An organization **singleton**, with no DELETE on the route: `terraform destroy` leaves the stored setting alone.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the poller sends posture alerts for this organization at all.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id. Posture alerting is an organization singleton, so this is the only value it ever takes and it is what `terraform import` addresses.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# An organization singleton: there is only ever one, and it has no id of its
# own, so it imports under the organization id.
terraform import infrawrench_posture_alert_settings.this org_01HXYZABCDEF
```
